reward_tooltip: Bet at least {{minBet}} {{minBetCurrency}} and win at a {{multiplier}}x multiplier or higher. The first {{winnerSlots}} qualifying players win the reward.
details_description: Bounty challenges reward you with prizes for winning big. In any of the listed games, simply place a qualifying bet that meets the minimum bet amount that hits the required multiplier - if you're among the first to do it, the reward is yours.
how_it_works_1: - Each Bounty challenge is tied to a specific game
how_it_works_2: - Place a bet that meets the minimum bet amount
how_it_works_3: - Hit the target multiplier or higher to complete the challenge
how_it_works_4: - The first players to complete the challenge win the reward
how_it_works_5: - You can win multiple times on the same challenge if there are multiple prizes awarded
claim_distribution_1: Rewards will be credited to your wallet in the currency specified for each challenge.
claim_distribution_2: You can claim your reward anytime from the "My Completed" tab in the Bounty page.
claim_distribution_3: There is no time limit to claim.
eligible_bets_1: - Only real money bets count. Bets placed using Slot Bonus Wallet or Free Spins do not qualify.
eligible_bets_2: - Your bet amount must meet or exceed the minimum bet amount shown on the challenge.
general_terms_1: - Bounty rewards are calculated and credited in the currency configured for each challenge, then displayed in your preferred currency for convenience. Please note, currency conversions are approximate.
general_terms_2: - The casino reserves the right to modify or revoke eligibility at any time, without the obligation to justify. Any abuse or fraudulent activity will lead to disqualification from the promotion.
youHitMultiplier: You hit <0>{{multiplier}}x</0>! Bounty completed, claim your reward now!
forbidden: Your account is currently restricted from bounty rewards. The winning multiplier is not included in the winning statistics.
